@cli/age.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.

@cli/browser-walk.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.

@cli/curl.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/curl.note: On Windows resolve the curl executable (curl.exe), not a PowerShell alias with different argument semantics. A native web-fetch capability is not this CLI alias.
@cli/curl.purpose: Probe an HTTP endpoint using the curl executable.

@cli/docker.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.

@cli/host-artifacts.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.

@cli/mc.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/mc.note: Resolve the MinIO Client executable; another program also named mc is not a valid binding. HTTP or SDK access requires its own explicit invocation.

@cli/node.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.

@cli/psql.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@cli/shell.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/shell.note: Resolve to the session shell (PowerShell, bash or another declared shell); do not assume bash on Windows. Arguments remain separate data until encoded for that shell.
@cli/shell.purpose: Run a declared command in the active session shell.

@cli/sops.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/sops.note: Never emit decrypted credentials into the conversation or tool logs. Resolve and consume within the authorized operation.
@cli/sops.purpose: Use SOPS in the fixed credential-consuming operation.

@remote/ghcr.purpose: A container image pinned by digest.

@remote/git.bind: Explicit remote URL and observed remote commit.
@remote/git.purpose: A named Git remote of the bound repository.

@remote/github-actions.bind: Repository identity, run id, head commit and observed conclusion.

@remote/minio.bind: Endpoint, bucket, key, and observed object version or content digest.
@remote/minio.purpose: An object in the explicitly bound MinIO store.

@remote/npm.bind: Registry URL, exact package version and package integrity.

@tools/agent.bind: Resolve the active host delegation capability at invocation time. Require availability, user authorization where applicable, bounded context and declared ownership. Wait for the returned evidence before consuming it.
@tools/agent.purpose: Dispatch bounded work or independent review to a separate agent and receive its result through the active session.

@tools/browsercontrol.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/browsercontrol.purpose: Drive a real browser against a served route: navigate, act, capture screenshots and DOM measurements.

claude.via: mode required: the in-app Browser pane, or Claude in Chrome when the task needs the person's sessions

openai.via: mode required: Codex computer use, which opens the person's own Chrome, on a dedicated browser profile (the shared UAT identity), never the person's logged-in profile

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/imagegen.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/imagegen.purpose: Produce artwork: a digital image from an image model, made to one stated claim. Rendering HTML is the visualize tool, not this one.

claude.via: none; a judged step records that no artwork could be made and the branch continues; a required step blocks with the operator's own code

openai.via: the OpenAI image model available to the Codex session

@tools/imageview.bind: Image inspection capability advertised by the active session; inspect actual pixels, not filenames or metadata.
@tools/imageview.purpose: Inspect image pixels through session image input or an image viewing tool.

claude.via: Attached images or an image-capable file reader.

openai.via: Attached images or an available image viewing tool.

@tools/print.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/print.purpose: Present text and artifacts in the conversation using the host rendering capabilities.

claude.via: the session's file and render hand-off, which displays an image or an HTML page in the conversation and falls back to the path or the URL

openai.via: the absolute path or the URL printed into the conversation, with the image inline where the client renders one

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@tools/visualize.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/visualize.purpose: Create a visual explanation or preview through the active session; record any produced files as outputs.

claude.via: files written by the Claude Code session

openai.via: files written by the Codex session

@tools/websearch.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/websearch.purpose: Read public web pages to close one named gap in the evidence; results are references with URLs, never authority.

note: Closed registry of workspace locations, session capabilities, CLI commands and remote resources. Resolve the longest registered prefix with a slash boundary. Alias declarations do not grant permissions. Root bindings come from the active invocation; missing bindings fail explicitly.

cli.en: Named executables or shipped script entry points invoked as commands in the selected shell.

remote.en: Internet. Registries, git remotes, image registries, CI runs, object storage. Read through a network; bound by version, digest, or observed head.

tools.en: Capabilities invoked through the active agent session, including file access, web search, image generation, visualization, browser control and artifact presentation.

workspaces.en: Bound local workspace, work-record directories and skill runtime files. All local resource aliases share this namespace.
